purpose: Unrestricted search for any automatable, cash-funded strategy that beats SPY. Methods are not limited (AI, quant, active, alternative data, crypto). Limits kept: no borrowing, shorts, leveraged or inverse products; and evidence must not come from the same data used to choose the strategy.

track_A_live_fund_census.universe: Every US-listed ETF in the Nasdaq Trader symbol directory (file created 2026-10-22) with Yahoo adjusted prices covering 2016-10-14 to 2026-10-16. Excluded and counted: leveraged or inverse funds (name contains 2X, 3X, 1.5X, Ultra, Leveraged, Inverse, Short, Bear, Bull, -1X, Daily), volatility (VIX) products and single-stock funds.
track_A_live_fund_census.costs: Fund expenses already in prices; 0.10% on entry and exit.

pass_rules_all_required.A1: CAGR at least 3.0 percentage points above SPY over 10 years.
pass_rules_all_required.A2: Selection-aware: the fund's monthly excess-return t-statistic exceeds the 95th percentile of the maximum t across all eligible funds under a null of zero excess (stationary bootstrap, mean block 6 months, 2,000 draws).
pass_rules_all_required.A3: Ahead of SPY in both 5-year halves.
pass_rules_all_required.A4: Maximum daily-close drawdown no more than 10 points deeper than SPY's.
pass_rules_all_required.A5: Fama-French five factors plus momentum alpha at least 2 percentage points a year with t >= 2, so the lead is not just market, size, value, profitability, investment or momentum exposure.

track_A_live_fund_census.known_bias: Dead funds are missing (survivorship) and funds that were not yet 10 years old are excluded; both bias results upward, so a failure is more decisive than a pass.
track_A_live_fund_census.if_pass: Report as a candidate whose rule is 'hold this fund'; still requires a prospective tracking period before any money.

holdout_rules.split: Development data ends 2018-12-31. Evaluation (holdout) 2019-01-01 to 2026-10-16. In each track, the configuration with the best development Sharpe ratio is chosen before the holdout is computed; all configurations' holdout results are reported afterwards but cannot change the choice.
holdout_rules.H1: Holdout CAGR at least 3.0 points above SPY after costs.
holdout_rules.H2: Holdout Newey-West t-statistic (lag 6 months) of monthly excess over SPY at least 2.2 (one-sided 5% split over three tracks).
holdout_rules.H3: Ahead of SPY in both holdout halves (2019-2022 and 2023-2026-10).
holdout_rules.H4: Holdout maximum daily-close drawdown no more than 10 points deeper than SPY's.
holdout_rules.H5: Development CAGR also at least 3.0 points above SPY (same edge before and after the split).
holdout_rules.known_bias: Yahoo lacks most delisted stocks (track D) and the crypto history is short (track B).

track_B_crypto_with_spy.assets: SPY, BTC-USD (Yahoo), cash = BIL (T-bill proxy, ^IRX yield before BIL exists).
track_B_crypto_with_spy.configs: Bitcoin target weight w in {10%, 25%}, remainder SPY: (a) static, rebalanced monthly; (b) trend-filtered: BTC sleeve held only when BTC close > its N-day average, N in {100, 200}, else that sleeve in cash. 6 configurations.
track_B_crypto_with_spy.execution: Signals at daily close, trades at the next close. Costs 0.25% per side for BTC, 0.10% for SPY/BIL.

track_C_ml_etf_rotation.universe: SPY QQQ IWM EFA EEM XLB XLE XLF XLI XLK XLP XLU XLV XLY GLD TLT IEF LQD HYG VNQ DBC, cash BIL (22 risky ETFs, all trading since 2006-02 or earlier).
track_C_ml_etf_rotation.features: Per ETF at each month end: past 1, 3, 6 and 12-month returns, 3-month daily volatility, distance from 10-month average; plus market-wide 10y-3m Treasury spread and Baa-10y credit spread (FRED, lagged one month).
track_C_ml_etf_rotation.models: Ridge regression and gradient-boosted trees predicting next-month return, trained on all data up to the previous month (expanding window, first prediction 2009-01). Hold the top k equally weighted; if the top predicted return is below the T-bill rate, hold cash.
track_C_ml_etf_rotation.configs: model in {ridge, boosted trees} x k in {1, 3}; plus a non-ML control (top 3 by 12-month return) reported but not eligible. 4 eligible configurations.
track_C_ml_etf_rotation.execution: Monthly, trade at month-end close using signals from that close's data minus one month for macro. Costs 0.10% per side.

track_D_insider_purchases.data: SEC Financial Statement and Notes is not used; SEC Form 3/4/5 insider transaction data sets (quarterly, from the first available quarter). Open-market purchases (transaction code P) by officers or directors.
track_D_insider_purchases.signal: A stock enters when insider purchases filed on a day total at least $100,000 (configs vary the cluster rule). Entry at the next trading day's close after the filing date; equal-weighted positions; exit after the holding period; idle cash in BIL.
track_D_insider_purchases.configs: holding period in {3, 6} months x cluster rule in {any qualifying purchase, at least two distinct insiders within 30 days}. 4 configurations. Price at least $5 on entry. Maximum 50 concurrent positions (oldest-first priority).
track_D_insider_purchases.bias: Yahoo has no prices for many delisted stocks; such events are counted and dropped, which biases results upward.

track_E_inverse_reaction_pairs.idea: User proposal: find pairs where asset Y tends to rise after asset X falls (hit rate >= 56%), then buy Y when X falls. Long-only; no shorts or leverage.
track_E_inverse_reaction_pairs.universe: About 90 unleveraged ETFs with prices before 2007-12-31: US size/style, 9 SPDR sectors plus industry ETFs, single-country and regional equity, Treasury/credit/TIPS bonds, gold/silver/broad commodities/oil/gas/agriculture, currency ETFs, REITs. Volatility ETNs and leveraged/inverse funds excluded. Crypto excluded (no history before 2014). Every ticker may be X and Y; X != Y. List fixed in pairs_universe in pairs.py before results.
track_E_inverse_reaction_pairs.signal: X period return below threshold at close of period t. Trade Y at the NEXT trading close (one-day execution delay), hold one period. Same-close execution reported only as an optimistic upper bound, never for the verdict.

trigger: X return in its bottom 10% of the trailing 252 daily / 52 weekly returns

track_E_inverse_reaction_pairs.pair_selection: Development only. Keep pairs with P(Y up | trigger) >= 0.56 and at least 60 triggers; rank by Newey-West t of mean(Y return - SPY return) on trigger periods; take the top 10, at most 2 per Y.
track_E_inverse_reaction_pairs.portfolio: Default 100% SPY. Each period, equal-weight the Ys whose X triggered (unique Ys, total 100%); otherwise SPY. Cost 0.10% per side on turnover.
track_E_inverse_reaction_pairs.choice: Highest development Sharpe of the 4 configs, recorded before holdout is computed.
diagnostics: Holdout pair persistence: share of selected pairs still >= 56% and beating SPY on triggers, against 1,000 random equally sized pair sets from the same universe (placebo).
Unconditional base rate: share of up periods for each Y, because a 56% hit rate is ordinary for equities (about 53-56% of days are up).
